tools.name: get_runtime_info
tools.title: Get runtime info
tools.description: Report this process's @ironwallet/mcp-server version and compare it to the published npm package (dist-tags on the configured registry). Does not update or restart the server. If updateAvailable is true, tell the user and offer prepare_update; stage it only after they agree.
tools.purpose: Running version vs published npm package

tools.name: prepare_update
tools.title: Prepare update (applies on next restart)
tools.description: Stage a newer @ironwallet/mcp-server into this server's npx cache so the NEXT MCP restart runs it. Call only when the user explicitly asks to update (usually after get_runtime_info shows updateAvailable). The running server keeps its current version until the user restarts the MCP host; wallets and keys are untouched. Not available for global or local installs.
tools.purpose: Stage the npm update for the next restart

tag.description: npm dist-tag to stage (default "latest"), e.g. latest or preprod.

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.title: List wallets
tools.description: List the wallets in the local keystore with their addresses per network. Each wallet includes policy ({ enabled: false } when unset). Never returns private keys or seed phrases.

tools.name: accept_mcp_consent
tools.title: Accept MCP consent
tools.description: Record that the user accepted the MCP risk disclaimer in chat. Call only after showing the full consent text (from a previous create_wallets needs_consent response, or the skill) and the user explicitly confirms. Does not create a wallet. accepted must be true.
tools.purpose: Record chat acceptance of the MCP disclaimer

accepted.description: Must be true after the user confirmed they understand the risks.

tools.name: create_wallets
tools.title: Create wallets
tools.description: Generate one or more brand-new wallets (BIP-39). Requires a current MCP consent (accept_mcp_consent in chat, or the local wallet manager). Returns names and addresses only. Seed phrases are NOT returned to the agent. The response includes a local browser URL where the user can view and back up the recovery phrases. If consent is missing, returns needs_consent and the full disclaimer instead of creating wallets.

name_prefix.description: Optional name prefix, e.g. 'agent-hot'. Defaults to 'wallet'.

tools.name: open_wallet_manager
tools.title: Open wallet manager (browser)
tools.description: Open a local browser form to add/import/create wallets or back them up (reveal the recovery phrase). Returns a localhost URL for the user to open. Seed phrases are entered and shown ONLY in the browser and never pass through the agent. Use this whenever the user asks to add, import, create, or back up a wallet.
tools.purpose: Local browser UI to import / create / back up

tools.name: set_wallet_policy
tools.title: Set wallet policy
tools.description: Replace the spending policy of a wallet (chat intent is the authorization; no extra confirmation). FULL REPLACE, not a patch: read list_wallets first and pass every field you want to keep. enabled=false removes all limits. readOnly blocks send_transfer and execute_swap. maxPerTxUsd caps each send/swap by USD value at the moment of the operation (rate from the IronWallet backend; if the rate is unavailable the operation is rejected — fail closed). allowedRecipients applies to send_transfer destinations. Use only when the user explicitly asks to change limits.

wallet.description: Wallet name. Optional if only one exists.

enabled.description: false removes all limits; true enforces the fields below.

readOnly.description: Block send_transfer and execute_swap for this wallet.

maxPerTxUsd.description: Max USD value per send/swap as a decimal string, e.g. "50". Checked at operation time; rejected if no rate is available.

tools.name: get_deposit_qr
tools.title: Deposit QR
tools.description: PNG QR to receive funds (generated on the fly; IW mark, address under the code). Pass network for one chain; omit it for one QR per unique address. Does not move funds. Never returns keys or seed phrases. Show the attached image in chat when the host renders it. Each item also has qr_url — open that local URL if the user cannot see the QR, and always write the address in the reply.

wallet.description: Wallet name. Optional if only one exists.

network.description: Network to deposit on. Omit to return one QR per unique address.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Get balance
tools.description: Get the balance for a wallet on a network. Optionally pass a token contract address; omit for the native coin.

wallet.description: Wallet name. Optional if only one exists.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address. Omit for the native coin.

tools.name: estimate_transfer
tools.title: Estimate transfer
tools.description: Estimate fees for a transfer without sending. Returns fees and the number of transactions that would be signed.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address. Omit for the native coin.

tools.name: send_transfer
tools.title: Send transfer
tools.description: Send a transfer: sign locally with the wallet's key and broadcast via the IronWallet forward relay (estimate -> sign -> forward) for EVM, Tron, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Doge, Solana, XRP and TON. Irreversible once broadcast — no second confirmation. Returns the transaction hash (and operation id where applicable).

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address. Omit for the native coin.

tools.name: get_operation_status
tools.title: Get operation status
tools.description: Poll the state of a forward operation by its operation id.

tools.name: list_swap_networks
tools.title: List swap networks
tools.description: List networks available for swaps. Use before listing swap assets.

tools.name: list_swap_assets
tools.title: List swap assets
tools.description: List tradable assets. direction=from lists sell assets; direction=to requires fromNetwork/fromSymbol (and fromAddress for tokens) and lists buy assets. Enriches with wallet address and balance when possible.

tools.name: estimate_swap
tools.title: Estimate swap
tools.description: Get a swap quote (amounts, fees, operationId). Quote can expire — prefer execute_swap for sending (it re-estimates). Amount is a decimal string; set maxMode=true to sell the full balance (backend corrects amount).

network.description: Network id, e.g. ethereum, bsc, bitcoin.

address.description: Token contract address. Omit/null for the native coin.

decimals.description: Token decimals. If omitted, resolved via SWP catalog (paged). Prefer passing decimals (+ address for tokens) from list_swap_assets.

network.description: Network id, e.g. ethereum, bsc, bitcoin.

address.description: Token contract address. Omit/null for the native coin.

decimals.description: Token decimals. If omitted, resolved via SWP catalog (paged). Prefer passing decimals (+ address for tokens) from list_swap_assets.

amount.description: Sell amount as decimal string. Required unless maxMode.

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.title: Execute swap
tools.description: Execute a swap: fresh estimate → create → local sign → execute. Does NOT use the transfer relay. Irreversible once submitted — no second confirmation. Returns operationId and txHash; poll with get_swap_status.

network.description: Network id, e.g. ethereum, bsc, bitcoin.

address.description: Token contract address. Omit/null for the native coin.

decimals.description: Token decimals. If omitted, resolved via SWP catalog (paged). Prefer passing decimals (+ address for tokens) from list_swap_assets.

network.description: Network id, e.g. ethereum, bsc, bitcoin.

address.description: Token contract address. Omit/null for the native coin.

decimals.description: Token decimals. If omitted, resolved via SWP catalog (paged). Prefer passing decimals (+ address for tokens) from list_swap_assets.

amount.description: Sell amount as decimal string. Required unless maxMode.

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.title: Get swap status
tools.description: Poll swap order/operation status by operationId.
